verses.text: Ephraim feeds on wind, And pursues the east wind continually; He multiplies lies and violence. Moreover, he makes a covenant with Assyria, And oil is carried to Egypt.
verses.textZh: 以法蓮吃風，且追趕東風，時常增添虛謊和強暴，與亞述立約，把油送到埃及。

verses.text: The LORD also has a dispute with Judah, And will punish Jacob according to his ways; He will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.textZh: 耶和華與猶大爭辯，必照雅各所行的懲罰他，按他所做的報應他。

verses.text: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, And in his maturity he contended with God.
verses.textZh: 他在腹中抓住哥哥的腳跟，壯年的時候與神較力，

verses.text: Yes, he wrestled with the angel and prevailed; He wept and sought His favor. He found Him at Bethel And there He spoke with us,
verses.textZh: 與天使較力，並且得勝，哭泣懇求，在伯特利遇見耶和華。耶和華─萬軍之神在那裡曉諭我們以色列人；耶和華是他可記念的名。

verses.text: Even the LORD, the God of hosts, The LORD is His name.
Therefore, return to your God, Observe kindness and justice, And wait for your God continually.
verses.textZh: 所以你當歸向你的神，謹守仁愛、公平，常常等候你的神。

verses.text: A merchant, in whose hands are false balances, He loves to oppress.
verses.textZh: 以法蓮是商人，手裡有詭詐的天平，愛行欺騙。

verses.text: And Ephraim said, 'Surely I have become rich, I have found wealth for myself; In all my labors they will find in me No iniquity, which [would be] sin.'
verses.textZh: 以法蓮說：我果然成了富足，得了財寶；我所勞碌得來的，人必不見有甚麼不義，可算為罪的。

verses.text: But I [have been] the LORD your God since the land of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, As in the days of the appointed festival.
verses.textZh: 自從你出埃及地以來，我就是耶和華─你的神；我必使你再住帳棚，如在大會的日子一樣。

verses.text: I have also spoken to the prophets, And I gave numerous visions, And through the prophets I gave parables.
verses.textZh: 我已曉諭眾先知，並且加增默示，藉先知設立比喻。

verses.text: Is there iniquity [in] Gilead? Surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls, Yes, their altars are like the stone heaps Beside the furrows of the field.
verses.textZh: 基列人沒有罪孽麼？他們全然是虛假的。人在吉甲獻牛犢為祭，他們的祭壇好像田間犁溝中的亂堆。

verses.text: Now Jacob fled to the land of Aram, And Israel worked for a wife, And for a wife he kept [sheep].
verses.textZh: 從前雅各逃到亞蘭地，以色列為得妻服事人，為得妻與人放羊。

verses.text: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel from Egypt, And by a prophet he was kept.
verses.textZh: 耶和華藉先知領以色列從埃及上來；以色列也藉先知而得保存。

verses.text: Ephraim has provoked to bitter anger; So his Lord will leave his bloodguilt on him And bring back his reproach to him.
verses.textZh: 以法蓮大大惹動主怒，所以他流血的罪必歸在他身上。主必將那因以法蓮所受的羞辱歸還他。
